tbesh_html:
1) to spurn, contemn, despise, abhor
1a) (Qal) to spurn, contemn
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to spurn
1b2) to cause to contemn
1c) (Hiphil) to spurn
1d) (Hithpolel) to be contemned

strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; in Ecclesiastes 12:5, by interchange for H5132 (נוּץ), to bloom
strongs_1890.kjv_def: abhor, (give occasion to) blaspheme, contemn, despise, flourish, [idiom] great, provoke.
